entries.resolution: src/creatures/monsters/monsters.cpp deserializeSpell sets COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKARMOR and COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKSHIELD on a monster melee, so its damage is reduced by the target armor and shield defense (mitigated_by). monsters.cpp deserializeSpell: |min|,|max| totals, max=0 -> min, startDamage>min -> 0, tick default 2000 ms. Melee chance normalized to 100: monsters.cpp deserializeSpell: melee is scheduled by interval; the declared chance is not applied.
